allowance_rationale: No allowance under the promise-heart rule: one promise earns one heart.

promises.criteria: BAT is adopted beyond Brave as the web-wide unit of account for attention, or its protocols become web standards.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper (Brave Software, Jan 7 2018): BAT as the token for a decentralized ad exchange, with BAT and its protocols as a future part of web standards.

promises.rationale: BAT works inside Brave's ecosystem but is not a web-wide standard; the whitepaper's standards vision remains unmet.

promises.criteria: Ordinary users can opt into private ads in Brave and actually receive BAT for their attention.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper: users get privacy and security when viewing ads plus a share of tokens.
BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): Brave Rewards grew to tens of millions of users.
Brave Community payout thread: July 2026 Brave Ads user payouts processing normally.

promises.rationale: Brave Rewards has paid tens of millions of users since 2019; July 2026 payouts processed normally.

promises.criteria: Publishers and creators can register and actually receive BAT for attention to their content and tips.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper: publishers are rewarded in BAT based on measured user attention.
BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): over 2 million verified websites and content creators in Brave Creators.

promises.rationale: Over 2 million verified websites and creators receive BAT through Brave Creators.

promises.criteria: Advertisers can run campaigns on Brave Ads with private attribution and real reporting.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper: advertisers get less expensive attention, less fraud, and better attribution.
BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Brave, Feb 22 2021): Brave Ads served 2.5K+ campaigns from 400+ advertisers in 190+ countries.
basicattentiontoken.org: 400+ advertisers to date on the private ad network.

promises.rationale: Brave Ads serves thousands of campaigns from 400+ advertisers with anonymous accounting.

promises.criteria: Ad confirmation events are validated on-chain with a decentralized audit trail that participants can verify.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper section 3.5: beyond 1.0, make transfer and verification fully distributed on Ethereum using state channels and zero-knowledge proofs.
BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Brave, Feb 22 2021): Themis research on moving Brave/BAT ad operations on-chain.

promises.rationale: Themis produced research papers and an RFCC but no production on-chain deployment.

promises.criteria: The 300M BAT user growth pool is distributed as grants to early adopters of Brave and BAT.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper section 5.3: 300M BAT endowment for early adopters, up to 5 BAT per user.
BAT Ecosystem Growth page: Brave's BAT purchases fund user rewards for viewing ads.

promises.rationale: UGP grants were distributed to users for years; Brave's growth page documents ongoing BAT purchases funding user rewards.

promises.criteria: A native Brave Wallet ships on desktop and mobile, unifying Brave Rewards, custodial accounts, and non-custodial accounts.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Brave, Feb 22 2021): Brave Wallet plan to unify Rewards, custodial, and non-custodial accounts.
State of the BAT 2022 (Brave): desktop Brave Wallet released Nov 2021, mobile beta Dec 2021.

promises.rationale: Desktop wallet shipped November 2021; mobile beta December 2021.

promises.criteria: Brave ships an in-browser DEX aggregator letting users swap tokens with BAT fee and balance advantages.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Brave, Feb 22 2021): DEX aggregator with BAT transaction-fee and balance-holder discounts.
The Cryptonomist, Jul 8 2021: Brave Swap with 0x API integration live in the desktop browser.
State of the BAT 2022 (Brave): Brave Swap integrated into desktop and mobile Brave Wallets.

promises.rationale: Brave Swap with 0x integration went live in the wallet in July 2021.

promises.criteria: BAT becomes usable on blockchains beyond Ethereum.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Brave, Feb 22 2021): multi-chain support with many assets and blockchains.
State of the BAT 2022 (Brave): BAT bridged to BSC, Avalanche, Polygon, Gnosis Chain, and Solana with real wallet holdings.

promises.rationale: BAT bridged to BSC, Avalanche, Polygon, Gnosis Chain, and Solana with real wallet holdings.

promises.criteria: BAT can be spent on value-added services and partner offerings beyond ad rewards and tipping.

evidence.summary: BAT whitepaper section 3.5: plan to explore value-added services offered to users on the browser platform through BAT.
BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Brave, Feb 22 2021): research into BAT utility for search, e-commerce, and VPN.

promises.rationale: No durable broad spend utility yet; Roadmap 4.0 extends utility to purchases, offers, and loyalty but has not shipped.

promises.criteria: BravePay stablecoin protocol launches, giving users self-custody private on-chain payments.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): BravePay stablecoin protocol layer for self-custody private transactions.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026; no public launch yet.

promises.criteria: The Brave Rewards Card launches in virtual and physical form and pays BAT rewards on everyday purchases.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): Brave Rewards Card for everyday purchases in eligible countries, earning BAT rewards.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026; card partner and availability still to be announced.

promises.criteria: The unified Brave Wallet ships, combining saved payment methods, self-custody multi-chain crypto, and Brave Rewards.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): unified Brave Wallet redesign merging cards, crypto accounts, and Rewards.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026; community testing planned for fall 2026.

promises.criteria: Verified creators receive verifiable micro-royalty payments when AI products use their content.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): Creator Contribution Protocol for compensating creators when AI uses their content.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026; still in research and development with a dedicated post planned later in 2026.

promises.criteria: Brave supports x402 and Machine Payments Protocol transactions for agentic payments.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): browser support for x402 and MPP agentic payments.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026; implementation planned, not shipped.

promises.criteria: A share of net revenue from Brave Wallet features, the Rewards Card, and BravePay funds BAT buybacks supporting user rewards and creator contributions, with public disclosure.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): percentage of net revenue funds BAT buybacks for user rewards and creator contributions via the UGP Reserve.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026; buybacks are tied to future revenue sources that do not exist yet.

promises.criteria: Brave Rewards delivers an Offer Wall, loyalty tiers, and BravePass tied to purchases, wallet activity, and loyalty.

evidence.summary: BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Brave, Jul 9 2026): Rewards evolves beyond ads into offers, purchases, wallet activity, and loyalty.

promises.rationale: Announced July 2026 as the evolution beyond browser-based rewards; not shipped.

rationale: Researched the BAT whitepaper (Brave Software, Jan 7 2018), BAT Roadmap 2.0 (Feb 2021), BAT Roadmap 4.0 (Jul 2026), State of the BAT 2022, and the current basicattentiontoken.org site; fulfillment checked against live products and Brave's own delivery recaps.
